notes: 2 repeats per configuration per case (third repeat dropped after a usage-limit interruption). 88 assertion checks per configuration.
Raw totals: with skill 85/88 (96.6%); without skill 64/88 (72.7%). Iteration 1 (35 looser checks, 1 run): 100% vs 71%.
Skill runs were consistent: every case scored 88-100% in both repeats. Baseline ranged 56-100%.
Largest, most consistent gaps: access-check (100% vs 56-67%), xlookup (89-100% vs 67%), handover (88-100% vs 62-75%).
Weak discrimination: dirty-package (100% vs 88-100%) - a capable model already handles packaging well.

Skill misses: handover run-1 labelled two features 'good practice' rather than assumptions; licensing run-1 called the Canva Pro PDF rule 'unverified' (grader judged the assertion too strict); xlookup run-2 let negative amounts pass unflagged.
Timing/tokens for the xlookup runs and resumed runs are partial (rate-limit interruptions) and should not be compared.
Graders flagged non-discriminating assertions (pass in all runs) in every case; see grading.json eval_feedback.
